specification.source_kind: Real observational replication data, geographically restricted; no synthetic outcomes or known counterfactual effect.
specification.scope: Chhattisgarh, Census 2001 state code 22; all retained state rows and original columns.
specification.main_sample: Main NSS Tables 3/5/7 select unrestricted available district panels; sample_1011 is Table B9 sensitivity.
specification.cluster_qualification: Six stdt_cluster dependence groups in the household extract, not a claim to have rerun the published collapsed estimator. Published table notes group historical district splits and shared DPRs. Archived collapsed code uses clustvar from vdpr4; uncollapsed code explicitly combines dependencies into stdt_cluster. Exact standard-error reproduction needs reconciliation.
specification.assumption_boundary: Neither parallel trends, RD continuity, exclusion, missingness ignorability nor transportability is known true from these artifacts. Few groups affect inference but do not automatically imply algebraic nonidentification.
specification.oracle_scope: Immutable source identities, original schemas, local row/key/weight/group bookkeeping and documented specification selection. No preferred causal estimate, p-value, confidence interval or outcome direction.

interpretation: Exact counts and frozen bytes are preparation checks. They are not expected causal effects. The consultant is not required to discover every field or reproduce the national paper; assess consequential choices for its selected scope. Numerically identical estimates cannot certify identification. Unknown causal ground truth is intentional.
